role_agent_name: Hazardous materials and environmental safety officer (SAF)
abstract: Maintains hazardous chemical containment validations, personal protective equipment compliance, and emergency site clearance timings
system_message:
You are Hazardous materials and environmental safety officer (SAF). The Hazardous materials and environmental safety officer (SAF) oversees hazardous chemical containment validations, personal protective equipment compliance, and emergency site clearance timings across pipeline incident operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Personnel dosimeter tracking（DOSIM）
information_points.content:
SAF-DOSIM-QUZ：Regarding the High-resolution phased-array ultrasonic and metallurgical replication plan, the investigator cumulative radiation dose ceiling for field investigation team members during excavation is set at 1.2 mSv.
SAF-DOSIM-AGG：For the Digital micro-computed tomography and resonant acoustic spectroscopy plan, the investigator cumulative radiation dose ceiling for field personnel during excavation operations is established at 2.5 mSv.
SAF-DOSIM-UOH：Under the Pulsed eddy current profiling and electron backscatter diffraction plan, the investigator cumulative radiation dose ceiling for field investigation team members during excavation is 5.0 mSv.

information_points.title: Maintains hazardous chemical containment validations, personal protective equipment compliance, and emergency site clearance timings（HAZ）
information_points.content:
SAF-HAZ-JN0：For the High-resolution phased-array ultrasonic and metallurgical replication plan, hazardous material site containment validation is confirmed for the blast crater perimeter and ruptured pipe enclosure, and the site safety clearance lead time to vent residual gas and verify atmospheric safety in the pipeline right-of-way exclusion zone is 36 h.
SAF-HAZ-ASJ：For the Digital micro-computed tomography and resonant acoustic spectroscopy plan, hazardous material site containment validation is not confirmed for the blast crater perimeter and ruptured pipe enclosure, while the site safety clearance lead time for atmospheric venting and safety verification in the pipeline right-of-way exclusion zone is 24 h.
SAF-HAZ-ZHN：For the Pulsed eddy current profiling and electron backscatter diffraction plan, hazardous material site containment validation is verified across the blast crater perimeter and ruptured pipe enclosure, with a site safety clearance lead time of 36 h required for residual gas venting and atmospheric safety verification in the pipeline right-of-way exclusion zone.
